alternative_explanations: Any apparent shared advantage may arise from pooled sample count rather than a transferable predictive state; the source-identical independently fitted ablation isolates pooling.
confounds: Anonymous structural token shapes may statistically reveal families; explicit family labels, native types, slot dispatch, hand-written ontology, test-target access, seed collision or post-score tuning invalidate rather than score the cohort.
falsification_criteria: Discard this implementation without tuning if overall transfer is below 0.95, any family mean is below 0.90, or shared fitting fails to exceed the source-identical independent ablation by 0.05 on both overall and minimum-family accuracy.

outcome_policy.negative: A crash rejects only the implementation; semantic baseline failure, leakage, integrity change or state breach invalidates the cohort and forbids architectural interpretation.
outcome_policy.null: A valid null or registered specialist Pareto dominance makes this fixed width-32 recurrent implementation dormant without width, optimizer, feature or decoder tuning.
outcome_policy.positive: A valid one-seed success keeps HYP-0019 proposed and authorizes only a disjoint three-seed adversarial replication, not promotion.

predicted_outcome: Pooled recurrence may learn reusable transition statistics, but prior shared learners make failure to reach 0.90 minimum-family accuracy more likely; a valid >=0.95 overall, >=0.90 minimum-family and >=0.05 pooled advantage would authorize replication only.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; authorize only a preregistered three-seed adversarial screen if every capability and sharing gate passes and no implementable registered suite Pareto-dominates the shared learner under full R16 accounting.
research_question: Can one family-blind width-32 recurrent predictive-state learner fitted once on pooled anonymous training worlds transfer to four runner-random unseen families better per fully charged cost than the source-identical independently fitted learner and registered native probabilistic specialist suites?
title: Shared recurrent predictive state across four unseen world families

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any derived training and scoring seed collision.
Invalidate if the shared candidate receives a family label or privileged native object.
Invalidate if any training or test value is truncated, sampled or encoded by a family-specific rule.
Invalidate if test results, targets or oracle fields are available during pooled meta-fit.
Invalidate on candidate tuning after any scoring output is observed.
Invalidate if the shared source dispatches on family, native type, slot identity or a hand-written ontology.
